It allows scripts to run in mixed precision, improving performance while maintaining accuracy. `autocast` serves as a context manager or decorator, wrapping the forward pass(es) of a network and any related loss computations. Tensors can be any type when entering an autocast region, and it is not necessary to manually cast models or inputs to `half()` or `bfloat16()`. The function selects op-specific data types for operations within an autocast region. Backward operations should not be run under autocast, as they execute in the same data type chosen for the corresponding forward operations.
